paragraphs: Mentioned in Menachot 53b, challenging Rabbi Chinena bar Papa. In Bereshit Rabbah 44:14, Rabbi Chiya, son of Rabbi Chanina, says, “Not as one lodging a complaint,” etc.

notes.text: The quoted complaint wording occurs in Bereshit Rabbah 44:14. The supplied citation instead reads ב״ק פ״מד־יד and remains a source discrepancy; it is not silently corrected to Bereshit Rabbah. The two father-name spellings in the heading are retained.

The saved whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah44:14 scalar explicitly has Rabbi Chiyya son of Rabbi Chanina saying Abraham was not lodging a complaint. This supplies the matching passage alongside the frozen ב״ק פ״מד־יד; it does not prove a printed ק/ר history or silently replace Hyman’s source letters. The quotation remains abbreviated. The prior root Menachot challenger reading is retained without a new anonymous-speaker reassignment.

Hyman’s print (vol. II, p. 444) reads וב״ר and gives Bereshit Rabbah 44:14, where the supplied Wikisource text has ב״ק. The consulted passage explains Abraham’s question as asking by what merit. In Menachot 53b, Chiya son of Rabbi Chinena explicitly challenges Rabbi Chinena bar Papa’s reading. Hyman gives both Chinena and Chanina in the heading.
